test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the following sentence to make it grammatically correct.

Only __the beautiful__ painting is to be displayed in the exhibition.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. the most beautiful .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is comparing one specific painting with all the others in the context of the exhibition.
 
• To express that this one painting stands out as the most excellent, the superlative form "the most beautiful" is appropriate.
 
• In English grammar, the superlative form is used to describe the highest degree of a quality among three or more items.

Correct sentence: *Only the most beautiful painting is to be displayed in the exhibition*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Form:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Adjective + -er (for short adjectives) or more + Adjective (for longer adjectives).
 
• **Example:** This painting is more beautiful than that one.
 
• **Usage: **Used to compare two items.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Form:**
 
 
• **Structure: **Adjective + -est (for short adjectives) or most + Adjective (for longer adjectives).
 
• **Example: **This is the most beautiful painting in the exhibition.
 
• **Usage: **Used to compare three or more items, indicating the highest degree.
